gbifID.description: Unique global identifier for each Romalea reticulata occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique UUID identifying the source dataset for all occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique web URL identifying each observation record.

species.description: Scientific name of the recorded grasshopper species, consistently Romalea reticulata.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific taxonomic rank is absent across all records.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship of the scientific name is missing for all records.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: Species observation status confirming presence at each recorded site.

individualCount.description: Number of Romalea reticulata individuals recorded per occurrence event.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data is unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation values are unavailable for all records.

year.description: Calendar year of the occurrence record.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier code for Romalea reticulata occurrence records.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for taxonomic type status in this dataset.
